_built_from: sample/zone_01.json and sample/layouts/zone_01.json, with the single door 'c023/exit' put back from ZONE_EXIT to SEALED and nothing else touched
_what: Zone 1 of the declared sample with its last room's exit put back to SEALED -- which is what EVERY default-scale Zone looked like before `ZONE_EXIT` existed. The engine appended its exit room off that face anyway, so the player could see the portal through a wall they could not pass. Its committed `layout` is the real one: a saved Zone carries both.
_why: A save holding a Zone like this has to keep working. `exit_reach_driver.gd` builds it BOTH ways and that is the evidence for what older saves do: WITH the committed layout it rebuilds exactly as saved, sealed exit and all, so nothing about that player's Zone changes; as a FRESH proposal it is refused, so the bridge composes another. Nothing is migrated and nothing is abandoned.
